vectors.description: arguments that are not an object are a format_error at the root
a required member that is missing is a format_error at its pointer
evaluate needs its input
a member of the wrong JSON type is a format_error at it
a member the tool does not take is a format_error at it
the tool's own members are checked before unknown ones
list_rulesets takes no members
a rule set the catalog does not have is a registry_error with the names it has
the rule set is looked up before the input is read
an input that does not read as data is a format_error pointing into it
a budget below 256 is a format_error at /budget
a budget above 1048576 is a format_error at /budget
a budget with a fraction is not a budget
any integral number is a budget: 2000.0 is 2000
